svg.title: Blood stem cell
svg.desc: Round hematopoietic stem cell with a prominent nucleus, thin purple cytoplasm, and subtle membrane ruffles. Biological basis: Hematopoietic stem cells are non-adherent suspension cells; their compact morphology and limited cytoplasm distinguish them from mature myeloid cells.
